title: Decision card
description: Every decision the human must make arrives in this format. Synthetic example below.

effect.description: Numbers with their unit (items vs rows vs product codes) and source file hash

detail.description: What happens if chosen, incl. rollback for risky actions

examples.title: Should discontinued products appear in the Top tier?
examples.what: Some recommended products are no longer sold but can be made to order.

options.label: Top, labeled
options.detail: Shown first with 'discontinued, may need custom production'.

options.label: Optional only
options.detail: Still visible, never in the short list.

examples.why: Keeps the short list actionable while not hiding the opportunity.
